catalog: Authored small fictional name catalogs in lib/names.ts
purpose: Birthplace-appropriate fictional examples, not identity or ethnicity inference
referenceScope: CLDR describes name parts and ordering, not the accuracy or frequency of this authored catalog
notes: All 217 economies resolve to an explicit birthplace mapping or a labelled regional fallback.
Some countries use multiple example traditions. Selection within the catalog is a game rule, not a population-frequency estimate.
Chinese, Japanese and Korean profiles use native writing; other profiles use native writing or readable transliteration.
The catalogs do not cover every language, ethnicity, religion, generation or naming tradition in a country.
Old save names are retained until the player explicitly saves a replacement. Name previews do not consume fate RNG.
